species.name: Trout
why: Water 61°F on top, right in their comfort range.
Best water today is 8–40 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.

species.name: Striped bass
why: Water 61°F on top, a bit cool for them, so they feed in the warmest water they can find.
Best water today is 8–26 ft deep, mostly on open water over the deep basin.
The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.
Little oxygen below about 75 ft, so fish stay above it.
North wind at 22 mph pushes bait onto the south shore: try the wind-blown banks.

The lake is layered: warm water down to about 50 ft, cold below.

species.name: Largemouth bass
why: Water 61°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
